subject: Day-of update: flight diverted — option to shorten loop to 30m or reschedule?
messages:
From: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@gmail.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, Sep 12, 2026 at 8:17 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite interview today — running late

Hi Naomi,

Quick heads-up — my flight got diverted because of a mechanical stop and I'm now stuck on the tarmac in SFO. They're estimating about a 45–60 minute delay before we can get airborne again. I can still make the interview but will be ~50 minutes late for the 10:00am PT slot.

If it helps the team, I'm fine with a shortened conversation (30 minutes) that focuses on system design and the product case, or we can reschedule to the earliest slot you have next week (I'm flexible on Tue/Wed afternoons). Sorry for the scramble — hate to disrupt the panel.

Thanks for understanding,
Alyssa

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Cole <sarah@talentbridge.com>, Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@gmail.com>
Date: Sat, Sep 12, 2026 at 8:30 AM -0700
Subject: FW: Day-of update: flight diverted — option to shorten loop to 30m or reschedule?

Team — forwarding Alyssa's note. She'll be ~50 minutes late for the 10:00am PT onsite slot. Two options in my mind:

1) Condense today's session to a 30-minute core loop (system design + 1 behavioral question). We can skip the coding exercise and the blue-team deep-dive.
2) Move the full 60-minute loop to next Tue/Wed afternoon (I'll coordinate availability).

If we go with option 1, I attached a quick "30min_panel_guidance.docx" that highlights which topics to prioritize and a suggested 5/10/15 minute split. Marcus, Chloe — what's your preference? If you approve, I'll confirm with Alyssa and update the calendar (and inform the candidate of the shortened format).

Short answers appreciated — decision needs to land before 9:15 so interviewers can adjust prep.

Thanks,
Naomi
Recruiting Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: 30min_panel_guidance.docx

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: FW: Day-of update: flight diverted — option to shorten loop to 30m or reschedule?

+1 to doing the 30-minute compressed loop today.

If we compress, I'd focus the time on system design (30 min) and skip the coding so we don't penalize for the travel delay. Marcus, if you want product/behavioral signal, we can use two quick targeted prompts at the end (3–4 minutes each).

I reviewed the attached guidance — looks good. I'm happy to be the primary on design and can drop the take-home ask.

Chloe
Senior Staff SWE (Interviewer)

Thanks, Naomi and Chloe — I agree we should proceed with a compressed 30-minute loop today rather than pushing to next week. Main reasons: keeps momentum (we've had a long interview cycle) and it's better to capture synchronous interaction when possible.

Plan:
- Naomi: please update the calendar event to 10:50am PT and set the event length to 30 minutes. Mark the agenda: 5m intro/role context (Priyom), 20m system design (Chloe leads), 5m product/behavioral (Marcus).
- Chloe: lead the design conversation and prioritize candidate's trade-offs and scaling decisions; skip coding.
- Priyom: quick intro and note-taking + fit signal.
- Naomi: confirm with Alyssa and send her the adjusted Zoom link (I've included a buffer on my end).

Naomi — once you confirm with the candidate, loop back here and I'll join live.

Marcus Lin

Redwood Inference
